title: Some newer emoji render as empty boxes in Roblox's interface font
observation: In a Roblox Studio play session the HUD's icons drew the hook (U+1FA9D), the person playing handball (U+1F93E) and the coin (U+1FA99) as empty boxes, while older emoji in the same labels (crossed swords, fishing pole, ghost, bomb, American football, fire, collision, cyclone, tornado, boar) drew correctly.
recommendation: Check every emoji used as an interface icon in a screenshot before relying on it, prefer long-established emoji, and keep a short word or a shape as the fallback for anything essential.
applies_when: Interface icons or labels use emoji glyphs in Roblox TextLabels
limits: One Windows PC in October 2026; fonts on phones, consoles and Macs were not checked

evidence.detail: Section 31, bug 7, and the art direction's V13 screen notes: the three glyphs showed as boxes in screenshots and were replaced.
